description_zh: 调用DescribeHybridMonitorTaskList接口查询数据接入任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun cms describe-hybrid-monitor-task-list --keyword task --task-id 360000 --group-id 36070000 --namespace aliyun --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --include-aliyun-task true --task-type aliyun_fc --target-user-id 1208863178610000 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridMonitorTaskList

parameters.help_en: The keyword that is used for the search
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The ID of the metric import task
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the application group.

For information about how to obtain the ID of an application group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115032.html
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组ID。

关于如何获取应用分组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115032.html
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the namespace.

For information about how to obtain the name of a namespace, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428880.html
parameters.help_zh:
指标仓库名称。

关于如何获取指标仓库名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428880.html
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

起始值：1。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the returned result includes metric import tasks for Alibaba Cloud services. Valid values:

- true (default): The returned result includes metric import tasks for Alibaba Cloud services.

- false: The returned result excludes metric import tasks for Alibaba Cloud services
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果是否包含阿里云产品的数据接入任务。取值：

- true（默认值）：包含。
- false：不包含
parameters.name: include_aliyun_task

parameters.help_en:
The type of the metric import task. Valid values:

- aliyun\_fc: metric import tasks for Alibaba Cloud services

- aliyun\_sls: metrics for logs imported from Log Service
parameters.help_zh:
监控任务类型。取值：

- aliyun_fc：阿里云产品的数据接入任务。
- aliyun_sls：SLS日志的监控项
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member account.

> This parameter is required only if you use a management account to call this operation to delete the metric import tasks that belong to a member in a resource directory. In this case, the `TaskType` parameter is set to `aliyun_fc`
parameters.help_zh:
成员ID。

> 仅当您通过管理账号调用本接口删除成员的阿里云数据接入任务（即`TaskType`为`aliyun_fc`）时，需要设置该参数
parameters.name: target_user_id
